name: sa.daall/index
title: DaallIndex — Saudi Government Awards Index
description: Saudi government contract awards index (Etimad): listed companies and top buyers. Read-only.

tools.name: index_level
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much the Saudi government is awarding in contracts, overall or in one sector, or how that changed over a year. Returns the Daall Government Awards Index (DGI) or one sector index: the level, awards in the last 12 months in SAR bn, the change on a year earlier, and the page url. Not for a single company, buyer or tender. استعملها لسؤالٍ عن حجم الترسيات الحكومية السعودية كلّها أو في قطاع، وتغيّرها عن سنةٍ مضت.

code.description: DGI (default) or a sector code: CAPG, CPS, SOFT, CONS, TRAN, UTIL, TELE, HLTH

tools.name: listed_company
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much a company listed on Tadawul or Nomu won in Saudi government contracts, where it ranks among listed companies, or which government entities buy from it. Takes a ticker (e.g. 7203) or a company name in Arabic or English. Returns the award value and count for the year, the rank, expected government revenue as a share of reported revenue, the three largest buyers by name, and the page url. Covers listed companies that won awards in the year; not for unlisted companies or single tenders. استعملها لسؤالٍ عن ترسيات شركة مدرجة في تداول أو نمو: قيمتها وعددها وترتيبها وأبرز الجهات المشترية منها.

query.description: الرمز أو الاسم / ticker (e.g. 7203) or company name in Arabic or English

tools.name: buyer_summary
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much a large Saudi government entity (a ministry, authority or directorate) awarded in contracts over the last 12 months, how that changed, or who its largest winners are. Takes the entity name in Arabic or English. Returns the award value and count, the change on the previous 12 months, the rank, the three largest winners by name, and the page url. Covers the 15 largest buyers only; not for a single tender. استعملها لسؤالٍ عن ترسيات جهة حكومية كبرى في 12 شهراً وتغيّرها وأبرز الفائزين بعقودها.

query.description: اسم الجهة / buyer name in Arabic or English

tools.name: largest_awards
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about the biggest recent Saudi government contract awards. Returns the three largest awards of the last 60 days: winner, buyer, value in SAR m and date. Takes no arguments and does not filter by company, buyer or sector. استعملها لسؤالٍ عن أكبر الترسيات الحكومية السعودية الأخيرة.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when you have a company name, ticker, government entity, sector or topic and need the matching DaallIndex record. Searches listed companies, the largest government buyers, the indices and the research notes. Returns up to 10 results as {id, title, url}, with ids in the form company:<ticker>, buyer:<id>, index:<code> or research:<id>. ابحث باسم شركة أو رمزها أو جهة حكومية أو قطاع أو موضوع.

query.description: كلمة أو اسم أو رمز / a name, ticker, index code or topic

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this when you have an id from search results and need the full record. Takes one id (company:<ticker>, buyer:<id>, index:<code> or research:<id>) and returns {id, title, text, url, metadata}. يجلب السجلّ الكامل لمعرّفٍ واحد من نتائج البحث.

id.description: معرّف من نتائج البحث / an id from search results
